obligations.obligation: Author each binding from the contracts rather than copying another binding's implementation choices.
obligations.mutation: Generate the TS API from Python classes and treat Python behavior as normative.

obligations.obligation: Publish mappings and apply one shared corpus with equal results, event order, and failure codes.
obligations.mutation: Maintain independent expected results that accept a binding-specific failure code.

obligations.section: 1. A binding presents the interface, whole
obligations.obligation: Expose the entire agent interface without missing operations or additional agent features.
obligations.mutation: Omit cancellation or add a TS-only prompt-string overload.

obligations.obligation: Bindings only translate calls, types, and errors; they add no retries, caches, batching, reordering, filtering, defaults, or policy.
obligations.mutation: Retry executor work in TS or inject a Python-only provider default.

obligations.obligation: Use language idioms and publish a complete contract-to-local-name mapping.
obligations.mutation: Document startTurn without an exported method or leave a contract operation unmapped.

obligations.section: 4. The transport is invisible and disposable
obligations.obligation: Caller interfaces expose no engine argv, ports, framing, executable paths, transport envelopes, or required engine environment variables.
obligations.mutation: Require callers to provide enginePort or a Python executable path.

obligations.section: 5. The engine's own language gets a binding like every other
obligations.obligation: The engine's implementation language also has an owned binding, with no direct engine access.
obligations.mutation: Export AmplifierSession from the Python public package.

obligations.section: 6. No caller-facing command line is shipped
obligations.obligation: Do not ship a supported agent command interface; any CLI is only a development aid.
obligations.mutation: Publish a supported amplifier-agent run command in package entry points.

obligations.section: 7. A binding declares its contract versions
obligations.obligation: Expose public contract version declarations without invoking work and reject mismatched engines by name.
obligations.mutation: Defer mismatch until provider work or use package version compatibility instead.

obligations.section: 7. A binding declares its contract versions
obligations.obligation: Declare language-binding/1 independently of other contracts and release versions.
obligations.mutation: Use agent-interface/1 or the npm version as the binding contract version.

obligations.obligation: Interface/event changes update every binding in the same change set.
obligations.mutation: Land a new event field in Python while TS drops it.

obligations.obligation: Preserve ids, strict JSON, content ordering, exact integers, decimals, registered events, and owned extensions.
obligations.mutation: Round a JSON integer above 2^53 or discard an extension field while translating.

obligations.obligation: Native errors retain the complete inspectable record, including remedy.
obligations.mutation: Throw a plain Error containing only a formatted message.

obligations.obligation: Expose no engine escape hatch or binding-only feature, and keep policy out of binding implementations.
obligations.mutation: Add getEngine() as an undocumented supported method or a binding-local routing cache.

obligations.obligation: Bindings present the full contract, faces remain declared projections, and caller adapters add no agent semantics.
obligations.mutation: Expand HTTP into a host-tool callback protocol or prescribe adapter-owned retry policy.

obligations.obligation: Every shipped binding obeys the same rules, regardless of the chosen language set.
obligations.mutation: Exempt one supported binding from event or approval requirements.

obligations.obligation: Exclude binding-specific capability declarations and configuration.
obligations.mutation: Export supportedCapabilities or transport-specific per-binding options.

obligations.obligation: Every mapped operation and event resolves through the shared suite without dangling mapping entries.
obligations.mutation: Add a documentation mapping entry for a nonexistent event or method.

obligations.obligation: Scripted run, resume, and fork produce equivalent results and event ordering across bindings.
obligations.mutation: Normalize away a missing resumed event or different fork history.

obligations.obligation: Equivalent induced failures carry the same code and remedy across bindings.
obligations.mutation: Rewrite the remedy or change the code during TS translation.

obligations.obligation: Reject engine version mismatch and enumerate public exports to detect extra or transport-specific names.
obligations.mutation: Allow an incompatible engine because its transport handshake succeeds.

obligations.obligation: Compatibility evidence includes Python and an independently authored non-Python binding passing the kit.
obligations.mutation: Claim cross-binding compatibility from Python-only results.

obligations.section: 7. A binding declares its contract versions
obligations.obligation: Language-binding contract amendments within the major version remain additive.
obligations.mutation: Remove a binding guarantee without a new contract major.
